data.one_liner: Responsive navigation bar that adapts to screen size, collapsing into a drawer on mobile.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget that displays a full navigation bar on web and desktop, and switches to a menu drawer on smaller screens. It automatically handles layout changes based on device width.
use_when: You need a simple, responsive navbar for a Flutter web or desktop app
You want to avoid custom layout logic for different screen sizes
avoid_when: You require complex navigation logic with nested routes or deep linking
You need a highly customized design that cannot be achieved with the provided widget
weaknesses: Limited customization options beyond basic appearance
No support for advanced routing features
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec and import package

alternatives.name: responsive_framework
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides broader responsive utilities and layout builders for complex UI adaptations

alternatives.name: responsive_builder
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers similar responsive layout helpers with more configuration options
